This card is actually my 'fun' way to test creativity of new models. It's a very small, easy and actually low-effort card. It's supposed to generate a random boy you can interact with. Boys will be age between 8-12, so if you want a different range just edit that part in the description. 

Most LLMs will be fine with you saying 'Generate 10yo with opalescent hair'. So yeah, you can specify your need, but what fun is that? Engage in randomness!

You can 'vanish' any boy you don't like and 'generate' new one on a whim. Just add within apostrophes that he does disappear and you will be fine.

I hate using quotation marks for dialogue so system message/jailbreak are catered to that. You can go first person, present tense, description of actions in asterisks. It's meant to work like that. If you have a keyboard with numeric, it makes it easier to write with one hand (winky face).

This card barely works in NovelAI (their model doesn't understand what narrator is). GPT4 is shit at sex anyways so don't. Asha/Mars does okay-ish with some spurts of nice creativity. Any local LLMs that are specialized in ERP do great though.
